name: Mount Dora (United States)
description: Light blue field divided from a yellow upper fly by a wave, charged at the centre with a red and white striped lighthouse outlined in black, the Mount Dora lighthouse.
history: Mount Dora is a city in Lake County, Florida. According to the city website quoted on Flags of the World, a flag programme was proposed on 18 October 2016, the council chose the design on 27 April 2017 and the flag was raised in front of City Hall on Flag Day, 14 June 2017.

features.role: upper fly divided by a wave
